verified_facts.text: The suites were designed by Italian architect Piero Lissoni.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by world-renowned Italian designer and architect Piero Lissoni, each of the 58 contemporary suites serves as a haven from the mundane.

verified_facts.text: Each suite has floor-to-ceiling windows leading to a private balcony overlooking downtown Buenos Aires or the nearby docks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each has floor-to-ceiling windows leading to a private balcony that overlooks downtown Buenos Aires or the nearby docks.

verified_facts.text: The lobby has an installation of illuminated figures by artist Eugenio Cuttica.
verified_facts.excerpt: a LED-lit installation by local artist Eugenio Cuttica of a group of fiberglass figures standing atop white chairs in rows that extend from the lobby floor onto the wall

verified_facts.text: It is the first SLS hotel in South America.
verified_facts.excerpt: its first hotel in South America

verified_facts.text: The landscaping is by Enzo Enea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Lose yourself in the verdant landscaping of Enzo Enea.

verified_facts.text: LEYNIA is an all-day Argentinean grill influenced by flavors from Japan, built around open flame cooking.
verified_facts.excerpt: an all-day Argentinean grill influenced by flavors from Japan and celebrating the rustic allure of open flame cooking in a chic, modern setting

verified_facts.text: Leynia's evening menu includes open-flame grilled meats, ossobuco empanadas, Patagonian trout ceviche and teriyaki style shrimp.
verified_facts.excerpt: think open-flame grilled meats, ossobuco empanadas, Patagonian trout ceviche, and teriyaki style shrimp

verified_facts.text: The full-service Ciel Spa has steam rooms and relaxation areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge at the full-service Ciel Spa, featuring steam rooms, relaxation areas and treatments

verified_facts.text: There is a south-facing outdoor pool with a spacious sundeck.
verified_facts.excerpt: a south-facing pool with spacious sundeck

verified_facts.text: Spa massages and facials use the Yonka skincare brand.
verified_facts.excerpt: treatment rooms for massages and facials using Yonka skincare brand

verified_facts.text: The fitness center has natural light and is open to all guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Gym at SLS Puerto Madero is open to all guests

verified_facts.text: Rooms are listed as pet friendly.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pet Friendly

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a short walk from Santiago Calatrava's rotating pedestrian bridge, Puente de la Mujer.
verified_facts.excerpt: is a short walk to Santiago Calatrava

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a short walk from the Fragata Sarmiento, a historic naval ship that is now a museum.
verified_facts.excerpt: a historic naval ship, Fragata Sarmiento, which now serves as a museum

verified_facts.text: Puerto Madero's old docks and warehouses have been converted into office buildings, apartments, restaurants and bars.
verified_facts.excerpt: Puerto Madero’s old docks and warehouses have been converted or transformed into sleek office buildings, posh apartment buildings, restaurants, and bars

verified_facts.text: The nearby Ecological Reserve has walking trails leading to the Rio de la Plata.
verified_facts.excerpt: Don’t miss a stroll around the Ecological Reserve, a biodiverse oasis with walking trails that lead to the Rio de la Plata

verified_facts.text: Rooms have hardwood floors, a black and white palette and rainfall shower heads.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rooms feature hardwood floors, a black and white color palette, low-slung beds, rainfall shower heads in the peekaboo bathrooms

verified_facts.text: Balconies are furnished with a pair of butterfly chairs.
verified_facts.excerpt: private balconies furnished with a pair of butterfly chairs

verified_facts.text: The minibar is stocked with local snacks and wines.
verified_facts.excerpt: mini bar stocked with local snacks and wines

verified_facts.text: The hotel is at Juana Manso 1725 in Puerto Madero.
verified_facts.excerpt: Juana Manso 1725 (C1107CHI)

verified_facts.text: The mezzanine level has a lounge.
verified_facts.excerpt: head up to the mezzanine level and you’ll find a comfortable lounge for chilling

verified_facts.text: The hotel hosts meetings and celebrations.
verified_facts.excerpt: From lavish celebrations to business conferences, SLS Puerto Madero creates events that are a true feast for the senses.
